title: A bus named by a label with four entries: one on a label, one on a wire that ends at a label, one with no label and one whose label is no member
how: The label `D[0..3]` names a bus of the members D0, D1, D2 and D3 = 1 bus; the drawn `bus` line is not kept = 1 dropped `bus` element;
entry 1 goes from (100, 50) to (100 + 2.54, 50 + 2.54) = (102.54, 52.54), where the label D1 is = kept;
entry 2 ends at (102.54, 62.54), where a wire starts that ends at the label D2 at (110, 62.54) = kept: 2 entries kept;
entry 3 ends at (102.54, 72.54) with no label and no wire there = dropped for having no net label; entry 4 ends at (102.54, 77.54) at the label X9, which is no member of the bus = dropped;
one wire; no part and no pin, so no net (a net comes only from pins); one sheet.
